properties.name: reserveSupportingSpace
properties.description:
Always occupy the supporting-text line, even when there is no message.

The row is otherwise rendered only when there is something to show, so the
first validation error CREATES a line and shoves everything below it down —
the whole form jumps as you tab through it. Reserving the space is opt-in
because a field with no message would otherwise carry an empty line
everywhere, including dense and inline layouts. createFormController turns
it on automatically for the fields it manages, since those are exactly the
ones whose messages appear and disappear.

properties.name: value
properties.description: NOT reflected: typed values (incl. passwords) must never appear as a DOM attribute.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Form field name (host attribute — ElementInternals submits under it).

properties.name: pattern
properties.description: Constraint validation (forwarded to the inner input; surfaced via ElementInternals).

properties.name: autocomplete
properties.description: Input behavior passthrough (password managers / mobile keyboards).

properties.name: spellcheck
properties.description: Spell checking is enabled by default, matching the native DOM boolean property.

properties.name: clearable
properties.description: Show a clear icon button. 'internal' clears the value directly; 'external' emits mdClear and leaves value control to the consumer.

properties.name: passwordToggle
properties.description: Show a password visibility toggle. 'internal' toggles the input type directly; 'external' emits mdPasswordToggle and leaves type control to the consumer.

properties.name: showPasswordLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the password toggle while the value is concealed.

properties.name: hidePasswordLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the password toggle while the value is revealed.

properties.name: density
properties.description: Density scale: 0 (default 56px), -1 (52px), -2 (48px), -3 (44px).

properties.name: multiline
properties.description:
Multi-line mode.
- false: single-line <input> (default)
- 'auto-grow': <textarea> that expands as content grows (multi-line field)
- 'fixed': <textarea> with fixed height that scrolls (text area)

properties.name: rows
properties.description: Number of visible text rows for multiline modes. Defaults to 2 for auto-grow, 4 for fixed.

properties.name: speechToText
properties.description:
Speech-to-text via Web Speech API.
- 'internal': manages recognition internally, appends transcript to value
- 'external': emits mdSpeechResult on mic click, letting the consumer handle recognition

properties.name: speechLang
properties.description: Language/locale for internal speech recognition (e.g. 'en-US', 'de-DE'). Defaults to browser locale.

properties.name: restrict
properties.description:
Restrict input to allowed characters.
Presets: 'numeric', 'integer', 'decimal', 'alpha', 'alphanumeric'.
Custom: a regex character class string, e.g. '[0-9+() -]'.

properties.name: formatter
properties.description:
Formats the raw value for display.
Set via JS: `el.formatter = (v) => Number(v).toLocaleString()`.

properties.name: parser
properties.description:
Parses the display value back to a raw value.
Set via JS: `el.parser = (v) => v.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, '')`.

properties.name: formatOn
properties.description:
When to apply the formatter.
- 'blur': format on blur, show raw value on focus (default)
- 'input': format on every keystroke (live formatting)

properties.name: focusBorderWidth
properties.description: Border width when focused: 1, 2, or 3 pixels.

properties.name: appearFocused
properties.description:
Force the field to render in its focused visual state regardless of the
underlying input's actual focus. Use when the field acts as an *anchor*
for a popover, dialog, or menu, and the OS focus has moved into that
surface — for example the `md-time-picker` keeps its trigger field in
the focused look while the picker modal is open, so the trigger and
the modal read as one connected control.

Visual-only: affects the notched-outline width / colour, the floating
label position, and the leading-icon colour through md-text-field's
existing `.md-text-field--focused` rules. Does NOT alter formatter /
blur-format behaviour (those keep tracking real focus events), so
`formatOn="blur"` still flips between formatted and raw on real
focus/blur even while `appear-focused` is on.

properties.name: chipsWrap
properties.description:
When leading `chips` are slotted, allow them to WRAP onto multiple rows so
the field grows to fit them. Default `false`: chips stay on a single line and
the field keeps its normal height (the consumer, e.g. md-multi-select, is
responsible for handling overflow — clipping or a "+N" counter).

properties.name: debounce
properties.description: Debounce delay (ms) for the mdSearch event. Emits after the user stops typing for this duration. 0 = disabled.

properties.name: throttle
properties.description: Throttle interval (ms) for the mdSearch event. Emits at most once per interval while typing. 0 = disabled.

properties.name: inputRole
properties.description:
Promote the inner input to a WAI-ARIA **combobox**, for a composite that
owns the popup (md-autocomplete). The role has to live on the real textbox
— the one AT reads when it has focus — and this field renders it, so the
owner cannot put it there itself.

Whitelisted to `combobox`: it is the only role an owner has a legitimate
reason to place on a text input, and an open-ended role prop here would let
a consumer lie about the control.

properties.name: inputExpanded
properties.description:
Expanded state of the owner's popup. Emitted only with `input-role="combobox"`,
where `aria-expanded` is an allowed attribute (it is not on a bare textbox).

properties.name: inputAriaAutocomplete
properties.description: `aria-autocomplete` for the combobox — how typing relates to the popup.

name: Text Field
description: The library's single text-entry primitive. Filled and outlined variants, single-line or multiline, with optional clear / password-toggle / speech-to-text affordances, display masking via formatter/parser, a debounced/throttled search event, and the full constraint-validation API through ElementInternals.

notes: Native keyboard input and secure entry. Change commits on submit; HTML validity flags beyond required, JS formatter/parser/restrict and speech recognition remain unsupported.
clearable/passwordToggle external modes emit intent without mutating native state; internal and boolean true modes perform the change.

Participates automatically in AWCFormScope: source successful-value serialization, ordered entries, native validation and reset bindings; named external ownership uses AWCFormRegistryScope and awcFormOwner. Disabled is excluded; softDisabled remains a form participant.

Native Material/Compose appearance; CSS selectors, DOM APIs, browser form APIs, cancelable DOM events and source imperative methods are not compiled. Unsupported source properties are reported by the compiler.

Automatically registers with AWCFormScope for native name/required rules, successful-control data and reset. Declarative text rules use AWCFormRules; native regex/type and browser UI limitations remain explicit.
